label: Development directors at small US nonprofits
role: Development director or the staff member who leads fundraising
organization: US nonprofit with fewer than 20 staff and no dedicated grant writer
working_assumptions: Grant deadlines are tracked across spreadsheets, inboxes and calendars.
Application materials are gathered close to each deadline.
One person often handles grants alongside other fundraising work.
evidence_note: Working assumptions for a demonstration, not customer research.
